options.metric: Annual sum of number_of_pedestrians_killed across police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes
options.denominator: Not applicable; absolute count, not a rate or share
options.grouping: Calendar year derived from crash_date, 2013 through 2025 inclusive
options.reason: Summing the per-crash pedestrian fatality counts directly answers the requested annual number and a line chart makes year-to-year change easy to see.
options.answer: Recorded pedestrian deaths ranged from 101 in 2020 to 176 in 2013, and the annual total was 119 in 2025.
options.interpretation: This framing answers the annual-count question by summing number_of_pedestrians_killed for every police-reported NYC motor vehicle crash dated in each calendar year from 2013 through 2025, with calendar year derived from crash_date and no denominator. The plotted totals peak at 176 in 2013 and reach a low of 101 in 2020; the 2025 count is 119. This is a defensible direct count of recorded pedestrian deaths, but the data cannot establish whether the police-reported records are a complete, independently validated census of all deaths. The check found 0 missing crash dates in the file and 0 missing pedestrian-fatality values among 2,132,218 selected crashes, and full January-to-December date bounds in every requested year; all selected rows were kept, none were excluded or counted differently, and missing values were not made into a separate group.
